subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge — schedule technical deep dive

Subject: CloudBridge discovery — recap + next step recommendation

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and suggested next step:

- CloudBridge is evaluating a cloud marketplace listing and integration that surfaces enterprise-grade LLM endpoints for their ISV partners. They care most about predictable latency, model governance, and a clear onboarding path for partners.
- Primary stakeholders: Sophie (Platform PM) and Rajiv (Security/Compliance). Michael is internal partner lead.

Recommended next step: a partner-led technical deep dive/demo with Redwood SE to validate integration points (marketplace provisioning, tokenization, auth, and sample throughput).

Proposed attendees: Sophie, Rajiv, Michael, Marissa (partnership), Dylan (SE), and me.

I can help coordinate — Marissa, can you propose 2–3 slots next week that work for your team? I’ll align CloudBridge.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

2) Prep: Dylan, can you prepare a short demo that covers provisioning from a marketplace vendor view + a 15-min throughput test on a small sample?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-30 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-03-30 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-03-31 09:00–10:00

Sophie / Rajiv — do any of these work? If none, tell us preferred windows and we’ll adjust.

Cheers,
